questions.question:
In the following question, Select the number which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 
 

 
 
6

 
 
 
12

 
 
 
7

 
 
 

 
 
9

 
 
 
4

 
 
 
11

 
 
 

 
 
11

 
 
 
6

 
 
 
2

 
 
 

 
 
13

 
 
 
?

 
 
 
10
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is,

**(1st term + 2ⁿd term + 3rd term ) / 2 = 4th term**

For column 1:

6 + 9 + 11 = 26

26 / 2 = 13

For column 2:

12 + 4 + 6 = 22

22 / 2 = **11**

For column 3:

7 + 11 + 2 = 20

20 / 2 = 10

Hence, “11” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Six scientists R, L, T, S, N and P are standing in a row facing towards north (Not necessarily in the same order). N is standing to the immediate right of R. S is standing second to the right of P. Two scientists are standing between T and N. S is towards the left of L.

Which of the following is correct about the position of L?

options.text: Third to the right of R
L is at one of the end
Towards the immediate left of N

questions.solution:

S is standing second to the right of P and towards the left of L.

**Case 1:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb8cd49f274f1658463bed9c87a16f6cfe3cfd9573529c67359cc9184d53bf0f.png] **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71249d5d43c03f9f292aac35bb3cd35e5c58bdaf5610adeda0144276df442d35.png] **

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

18 : 323 ∷ 24 : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is,

18: 323

18: 18² – 1

Similarly,

24: **575**

24: 24² – 1

‘575’ that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

Hence, “575” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

Statements:

I. All A are K.

II. Some J are K.

Conclusions:

I. Some A are J.

II. No K is J.

III. All K are J.

options.text: Both conclusion II and III follows.

questions.solution:
Drawing the Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa4580b0e4333ec4af00b9f128efc54951b8d7a5f23f7d835e568405541b556a.png] 

Conclusion 1: Some A are J → False (This is definitely false)

Conclusion 2: No K is J → False (This is definitely false)

Conclusion 3: All K are J → False (This is definitely false)

Hence, neither conclusion follow.

23, 29, 31, 37, 41, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is,

23, 29, 31, 37 and 41 are consecutive prime numbers.

The number which will come next in the series is ‘43’.

The complete series is,

23, 29, 31, 37, 41, **43**

Hence, “43’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
By interchanging which two signs the equation will be correct?

9 × 11 ÷ 31 + 62 – 13 = 18

After interchanging the given two numbers, what will be the value of 3 + 2 ÷ 1 × 4 – 7?

4 and 7
questions.solution:
Interchanging the numbers ‘4’ and ‘7’ and using BODMAS rule,

3 + 2 ÷ 1 × 7 – 4

= 3 + 2 × 7 – 4

= 3 + 14 – 4

= 17 – 4

= 13

Hence, “13” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In a certain code language, ‘SHOES’ is written as ‘19815519’, ‘SEED’, is written as ‘19554’.

What is the code for ‘CHAIR’ in that code language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e1a2f0dc142ecfb544963c2209981c3e759d0cf81e91577dd86d50c0a2dc835.png] 

The pattern followed is,

For SHOES,

The place value of S is 19

The place value of H is 8

The place value of O is 15

The place value of E is 5

The place value of S is 19

SHOES → 19815519

And,

For SEED,

The place value of S is 19

The place value of E is 5

The place value of E is 5

The place value of D is 4

SEED → 19554

Similarly,

For CHAIR,

The place value of C is 3

The place value of H is 8

The place value of A is 1

The place value of I is 9

The place value of R is 18

CHAIR → 381918

Hence, “381918” is the correct answer.
